name: Lava Light
tagline: A 70s lava light, because your build status deserved a shag-carpet makeover.
description: Groovy wax drifts about in green while everything passes and amber while a pull request waits, and the whole thing breathes while a build runs, man. Break the build and it hits a rolling boil, hotter bulb and angrier wax, until you fix it. It even takes a few seconds to warm up, just like the real thing, because authenticity matters. With no Greenlight running it sits there cold and grey, like a lava light at a garage sale. Move it, resize it, and decide how lively the wax gets.
